description: Every tolerance the yard is judged against, in one place.

fields.options: These are the defaults for new documents. A Dropoff or Dropoff Final that already exists keeps the threshold it was judged against, so past results stay reproducible. Setting a value to 0 means an exact match is required — that is a real setting, not “unset”.
